clue.text: Plant produces vehicle abroad

parts.note: a car is a road vehicle
someone abroad is away from home

explanation.surface: A factory overseas turning out cars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant' reads as a factory, but it is the botanical definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Caraway is an umbelliferous herb grown for its aromatic seeds.

clue.text: Some heroic agent is in prison

indicators.note: some means only part of the words that follow is taken

parts.note: the letters run across the gap between the two words

explanation.surface: A brave spy has been locked up.
explanation.definitionFit: A cage is an enclosure for confining captives, so a prison.

clue.text: Covering for holding nothing that is lifted

indicators.note: in a down clue lifting something turns it upward, so it reads bottom to top
a word holding another has it inside its own letters

explanation.surface: A cover being raised from something empty.
explanation.walkthrough: O goes inside FOR to make FOOR, which is then read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A roof is the covering on top of a building.

clue.text: In danger up in the air

definitions.meaning: first meaning: exposed and vulnerable to attack
second meaning: undecided, with the result uncertain

explanation.surface: Something at risk while uncertain or airborne.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes both being exposed to harm and a contest or question whose outcome is undecided.

clue.text: Part with profit

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to give up or surrender something
second meaning: the return produced by an investment

explanation.surface: Sharing out the gains.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means to hand over or surrender; as a noun the return or income from an investment.

clue.text: Pitifulness of boy or girl with short stockings

indicators.note: something cut short loses its tail end, so the last letter goes

parts.note: Pat is a name used for either sex (Patrick or Patricia)
hose is an old word for stockings

explanation.surface: A child looking pitiful in stockings that are too short.
explanation.walkthrough: HOSE loses its last letter to leave HOS, giving PAT + HOS = PATHOS.
explanation.definitionFit: Pathos is the quality in art or life that evokes pity or sorrow.

clue.text: Smoker could be in need of one to settle

definitions.text: Smoker could be in need of one
definitions.meaning: first meaning: read as two words, what a smoker without matches asks for
second meaning: to come down and rest, as a bird does on a branch

explanation.surface: A smoker craving a cigarette to calm their nerves.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as A LIGHT, the answer is what a smoker asks for; as one word it is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To alight is to descend and come to rest, as a bird settles on a perch.

clue.text: A forerunner of "Hi!"?

parts.note: the surface reading: something that historically came before, an ancestor
the setter's reading: the formal greeting that the casual one replaced

explanation.walkthrough: The older, formal salutation on first meeting someone has largely been replaced by a casual hello.
explanation.definitionFit: This set phrase is a traditional formal greeting on being introduced, now often superseded by a breezy informal one.

clue.text: Correspondence shows I limit dues differently

indicators.note: arranged differently means put in another order

explanation.surface: A letter in which someone says they will cap their fees another way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Correspondence' suggests letters, but here it means likeness.
explanation.definitionFit: Similitude means resemblance, and correspondence in the sense of a close match between things.

clue.text: Excellent document is in favour

parts.note: a deed is a legal document

explanation.surface: A first-rate document that comes down on one side of a dispute.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in favour' reads as one phrase, but 'is in' is the link and 'favour' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A good deed is a kind act done for someone, which is what a favour is.

clue.text: Dwelling where hairpiece is needed by woman in the morning

parts.note: W is the abbreviation for woman

explanation.surface: A home where a lady must put on her wig first thing in the day.
explanation.definitionFit: A wigwam is a domed hut or tent once lived in by some Native American peoples.

clue.text: Dennis turns up, having misbehaved

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means flipping to read from the bottom upward

explanation.surface: Dennis arrives after behaving badly, as Dennis the Menace would.
explanation.definitionFit: To have sinned is to have done wrong, a stronger way of saying misbehaved.

clue.text: It allows public appearances of ornamental pets and film stars

definitions.text: It allows public appearances of ornamental pets
definitions.meaning: first meaning: a glass tank in which small orange pet fish are on show

definitions.note: loosely, what film stars live in: a life on constant public view
definitions.meaning: second meaning: the figurative fishbowl of celebrities, whose every move is watched

explanation.surface: A display case that shows off both pet fish and screen celebrities.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase serves literally for a tank of pet fish and figuratively for a life with no privacy, which is how film stars live.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom names any situation where everything one does is exposed to onlookers, like fish seen through glass.

clue.text: A horse sits like that, so she must fly

indicators.note: sitting like that means arranged in some other way, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A rider perched in an odd way on a horse, hurrying off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'she must fly' is a definition by description: her job keeps her aboard planes.
explanation.definitionFit: An air hostess is a female cabin attendant, whose work requires her to travel by plane.

clue.text: Go past with case undone, but we are wrongly blamed

indicators.note: undone means taken apart, so the letters can be rebuilt in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Travellers walk by with a burst suitcase and protest it was not their fault.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is spoken by the answer itself, so 'we' is the plural people who take the blame.
explanation.definitionFit: Scapegoats are people made to bear the blame for others' misdeeds.

clue.text: Bewildered since grain is swelling

indicators.note: bewildered means thrown into confusion, so the following letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone baffled as to why their grain store keeps getting bigger.
explanation.definitionFit: Increasing and swelling are both present participles meaning growing larger.

clue.text: Drink available after a second

indicators.note: after says the word for available comes behind the one for a second, so the clue order is swapped

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for second
handy means close by and available

explanation.surface: A drink that will be ready in a moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' places the second piece behind the first; a shandy is beer mixed with lemonade.
explanation.definitionFit: A shandy is a drink of beer mixed with lemonade or ginger beer.

clue.text: It's revealed as unfashionable

definitions.meaning: second meaning: no longer in style

explanation.surface: A trend exposed as passé.
explanation.definitionFit: The short adverb covers both something now public knowledge and something that has gone out of style.

clue.text: It's lovely to be arriving

explanation.surface: Someone delighted to be on their way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be' supplies the verb itself, which is then followed by its synonym for arriving.
explanation.definitionFit: Becoming means attractive or flattering, as in a becoming dress, so lovely.

clue.text: One lying in Hewlett-Packard type of bath

indicators.note: something lying in another thing is placed within it

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone stretched out in a bath made by a computer company.
explanation.definitionFit: A hip bath is a small tub in which one sits immersed up to the hips, so the word names that type.

clue.text: I'm hairless, but without regard for the consequences

definitions.meaning: first meaning: having no hair on the scalp
second meaning: going at something headlong and recklessly

explanation.surface: A bald speaker insists they are not reckless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I'm hairless' is spoken by the answer itself, so it describes the word. Going at something bald-headed is an informal phrase for charging in recklessly.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means literally without hair, and in an idiom also rash and heedless of risk.

clue.text: Young girl has to fib about a Sunday school

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes around the others

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation for Sunday school

explanation.surface: A girl has to tell a little untruth about her church classes.
explanation.definitionFit: Lassie is a Scottish and northern English word for a girl.

clue.text: It makes the goose go round

definitions.text: It makes the goose go round

parts.note: the surface reading: something that keeps a goose spinning or circling

parts.words: It makes the goose go round
parts.note: the setter's reading: the stuffing that bulks out a roast goose, making it rounder and making it feed more people

explanation.walkthrough: 'Go round' means both to be rotund and to stretch to serve everyone at table, both of which stuffing does for a roast bird.
explanation.definitionFit: This herb-and-onion mixture is the traditional British stuffing for roast goose or chicken.

clue.text: It's hard to get into good position

indicators.note: getting into something means going inside it

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Landing a good post is tough.
explanation.definitionFit: A niche is a suitable position or role in which someone fits well.

clue.text: At this place is her empty semi

indicators.note: semi means only partly there, so just a fragment of the next word is kept

parts.note: only the opening letter of the word is kept

explanation.surface: Here stands her unoccupied semi-detached house.
explanation.walkthrough: A loose device: 'empty semi' leaves only a scrap of 'empty', its first letter. A semi is a semi-detached house, one of a joined pair.
explanation.definitionFit: Here is the adverb meaning in or at this location.

clue.text: Man with sex appeal let the dust settle

indicators.note: letting something settle means it falls into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A heartthrob waits for things to calm down.
explanation.definitionFit: Stud is informal slang for a sexually attractive, virile young man.

clue.text: See pal awkwardly go by

indicators.note: done awkwardly means clumsily arranged, so the letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: Watching a friend shuffle past clumsily.
explanation.definitionFit: Time that elapses passes, so the verb is a synonym of the phrasal verb.

clue.text: Misadventure I had, masked by stress

indicators.note: something masked by another thing is covered over by it, so it sits inside

parts.note: accent is stress on a syllable
I'd is the contraction of I had

explanation.surface: Someone hiding a mishap behind the strain they are under.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stress' looks like worry, but here it is the emphasis placed on a syllable.
explanation.definitionFit: An accident is an unlucky mishap, which is what misadventure means.

clue.text: Nurse is returning, all but severe

indicators.note: returning means going back the way it came, so the short word is read right to left
all but means everything except one bit, so the final letter is dropped

explanation.surface: A nurse back on the ward, nearly as strict as ever.
explanation.walkthrough: In British hospitals a sister is the senior nurse in charge of a ward, so 'Nurse' is a fair definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A sister is a senior grade of hospital nurse, so the title stands for a nurse.

clue.text: Bluestocking has something for breakfast with the chairwoman

parts.note: an egg is a breakfast food
the chair of a body is its head

explanation.surface: An intellectual woman shares her morning boiled egg with the woman who runs the committee.
explanation.definitionFit: A bluestocking is an intellectual or scholarly woman, so an egghead, a highbrow.
